cohort: 80 women with term pregnancies (40 spontaneous birth, 40 induced birth)
finding: While mode of birth did not affect umbilical cord IL-6 levels, infants born via spontaneous birth had higher 1st and 5th minute Apgar scores.
mod_finding: Infants born via spontaneous birth had higher 1st and 5th minute Apgar scores compared to those born via induced birth.
